notes: Implemented Phase 1 (P0) of mobile responsiveness plan: negated TouchEvent/PointerEvent pan delta for direct manipulation convention (drag right → image moves right), preserved WheelEvent scrolling convention (unchanged), changed canvas touch-action from 'none' to 'pan-y' for selective gesture passthrough. Used TDD cycle: 5 failing tests → minimal negation fix → all 43 test suites green (18 new + 707 existing). World-review found no critical issues; added threshold guard test and diagonal drag test to address medium-severity gaps. No refactoring needed — surgical fix with no SOLID violations.
